text: The checked dispatcher acquires the folder semaphore and installs a scope guard before protocol-specific work. Early startup exits release it through that guard. After dispatch and the in-progress state succeed, guard.release leaves terminal release to the completion route. IMAP uses its URL listener; later Exchange uses a completion lambda. The original refactoring still rejects non-IMAP folders.
